subject: writing pull.map() result in a file

messages.author: 4bc65c882faeb53e
messages.subject: writing pull.map() result in a file
parts:
dear all,
I am building linkage maps using R/qtl. I failed to write the result of pull.map() in a text file as shown below:
> write.table(map_Attila,file="map_Attila_LG5.txt",sep="\t",quote=FALSE)
Error in as.data.frame.default(x[[i]], optional = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = stringsAsFactors) :
  cannot coerce class '"map"' into a data.frame

Could you please help me with this issue?
Thanks

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] writing pull.map() result in a file
parts:
In the call to pull.map(), use as.table=TRUE.

For example:

data(hyper)
map <- pull.map(hyper, as.table=TRUE)
write.table(map, file="map.txt", sep="\t", quote=FALSE)

karl
